answer: Pay per behavioral cluster, not per key. Each epoch, jurors fingerprint answers by lever, sentence skeleton and timing; identities sharing that quartz-hard core are merged into one cluster that splits a single reward, while each still posts its own bond. A farm of 100 clones stakes 100 bonds to earn one share, and if any member is caught recycling, every bond in the cluster is slashed. Hiding needs a truly different mind per head; a polished opal veneer over shared shale cracks along the seam.
